text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wooaah!! It's so big and spacious!
So this is the Luxurious 
Cruise Journey, huh?! Thanks for inviting me,
Top Road!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Not at all!
I'm glad you were able to come! 
Let's make some "Summer Memories"
together!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
They have a boarding party, fireworks show,
optional island tours,
and a summer festival!
This is going to be so much fun♪
Wait, what's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "Andromeda Galaxy" is coming. Therefore,
this may 
be "EXDFF"… Recommending formulation of a
"Plan B."

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The sun, the sea, and yours truly! Ah,
everything shines so 
brilliantly! Doto,
Ayabe-san!
Make sure not to burn your eyes!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-Okay… Opera O-san, the sun,
and this ship are all so pretty…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Nothing can hinder our radiance!
Hahaha! Shadows and storms,
come if you dare!!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, they actually came!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe this… That typhoon
suddenly
changed course and headed straight for us…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The party, fireworks,
and the optional tour
—all canceled it seems.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (Aww man, Top Road was so excited too! She was hanging weather charms in her room for good luck, but she's probably going to be sad about this…)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The weather may be disappointing,
but our trip is still on! 
Let's change our mindset and enjoy what the
cruise has to offer!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Woah, that was quick! 
Is your mental strength indestructible or
something?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
She's got a good point!
This is a luxury cruise after all! 
It's filled with plenty of gorgeous amenities
for us to enjoy!

Alright,
let's make the most of this trip! Whoo!
text_block_list.name: Miracle & Top Road
Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Target in sight.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bravo!! Having a stage on a boat isn't so bad,
wouldn't you agree?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, this is so soothing… 
This truly does have it's own charm,
wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Passenger A
text_block_list.text:
Aww, I came here hoping to make some summer
memories, 
but it doesn't seem much different from my
normal days off…

text_block_list.name: Passenger B
text_block_list.text:
Well,
there's nothing we can do about the
weather. 
Guess it was just bad luck, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
…Um, I have a suggestion. How about we 
create these "summer memories" ourselves?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I've got an idea!
The "Let's Make Summer Memories Plan." 
Would you be willing to go along with
that?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course I would!
What kind of performance did you have in
mind? 
Turandot? Aida? A Midsummer Night's Dream?
I'm fine with anything!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'll help too.
I have a feeling that if I leave
this to her, something bad might happen.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Umm, I may not be able to help much…
or even at all, but I'll do my best…!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe is also in the affirmative.
She seeks the "gateway 
to summer" as well,
so that she too may create these
"memories."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I was also instructed by Rudolf 
to "create summer memories together."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I agree! Let's make this a summer to 
remember and do something extra special!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Jeez,
everyone's working together so easily. 
You're super popular, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, everyone's so nice and kind. Now,
the question is, 
what should we do…?
Considering the circumstances, 
maybe we should have a live performance.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A live performance with a song with summer
vibes? That alone 
might not be enough… We didn't bring any
costumes either.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe has a suggestion.
We should "evoke" the wide-ranging 
summer customs throughout Japan through
straightforward choreography,
allowing for various "interactive"
possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
She will also provide "maintenance" for your
"costumes."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "perfect number" will be accomplished
in order to 
achieve these "summer memories." The best
answer is…
…a Bon Dance Festival!
text_block_list.name: Miracle, Doto & Vega
Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The Bon Dance Festival is happening in the
dining hall. Various snacks, 
such as chocolate bananas and candy apples
are also available.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This feast is the true Midsummer Night's
Dream!
Let's all dance the night away!

text_block_list.name: Passenger A
text_block_list.text:
Haha, a summer festival on a ship feels odd,
but not so bad either.

text_block_list.name: Passenger B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
I feel like I'm going to remember this for
a while… Hahaha,
why don't we dance the night away
together?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Top Road,
you're a great leader and an optimist,
huh? 
You've got incredible mental strength and,
with a single word,
you can make everyone follow you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
N-No way,
I'm nothing like that!
I was just feeling a little down is all…

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
When it started to rain,
memories started to flood back… 
I thought, "Ever since I was a child, 
I've been rained on every time I went
out…"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
If all the passengers felt the same way I
did at that moment…
Well,
I couldn't just stand around and do nothing
this time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want everyone to know that even on rainy
days or trips 
that aren't ideal,
that they can still create great memories.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Everyone else was just kind enough
to go along with my selfishness.
That's all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (Quick recovery from being down and the determination to fight for others…)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (It's no surprise that the others couldn't leave her to do it alone… She really is a natural born leader. She's seriously impressive.)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-We're going to begin the fireworks
display 
using fireworks images in the onboard
theater 
s-shoo— Nngh, I bit my tongue… Hyaah?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Doto-chan,
I'll help with the fireworks display!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Man, I can already tell this is gonna be a
great summer memory.
